newsitem.title: UK: Shell chief says oil price too high for fundamentals.
newsitem.headline: Shell chief says oil price too high for fundamentals.

text.p: International oil market fundamentals at the moment probably don't warrant oil prices quite as high as they are, Royal/Dutch Shell Group managing director Cor Herkstroter said on Thursday.
"If I look at fundamentals, just on that basis, doesn't justify the prices we have got at the moment," Herkstroter told reporters at a briefing.
"But there are many more factors like political facors, cold weather or warm weather -- unpredictable factors that have an impact," he added.
Oil prices in October hit a six-year high over $25 a barrel for benchmark North Sea Brent blend and have not strayed far below since.
Brent was trading at $23.60 a barrel on London's International Petroleum Exchange on Thursday afternoon.
